classification_detail: Proven: cauchy_estimate_taylor, geom_iteratedDeriv, geom_taylor_coeff, and entire_coeffs_tendsto_zero. The remaining frozen main theorem is false: f(z)=(1-z)^-1+(z-1)^-2 satisfies the hypotheses but has Taylor coefficients n+2.

sorry_locations: taylor_coeffs_tend_to_one (false as stated: higher-order principal parts are uncontrolled)
blockers: The contour integral determines only the residue. It does not rule out a higher-order or essential zero-residue principal part; the explicit second-order-pole counterexample refutes the conclusion.
